metadata.description: Azure region. Restricted to regions that currently host Voice Live realtime models.
Lowercase 3–10 char prefix used in resource names. Must be globally unique-friendly.
Environment tag (e.g. demo, dev, henry-review).
Voice Live realtime model deployment name. Default `gpt-realtime` is the current GA model.
Realtime model version. Pair with voiceLiveModel: gpt-realtime → 2025-08-28, gpt-4o-realtime-preview → 2024-12-17.

Realtime model capacity in thousands of tokens per minute (TPM). Default 1 (=1K TPM) is the minimum for a single-user demo. Bump to 5+ for sustained use; quota in shared subscriptions is tight (default ceiling is often 10).
Default TTS voice for the avatar. See Microsoft Speech voices list.
Default avatar character (lisa, harry, layla, etc.).
Default background image URL for the avatar. Empty string falls back to the bundled background.png shipped in the container.

defaultSystemPrompt.defaultValue: You are MAX, a friendly content guide for a TV streaming service. Help the viewer find a movie or show for tonight. Keep replies short, warm, and conversational.

metadata.description: Default system prompt / instructions for the realtime agent.
Container Apps workload profile.
Container image to deploy. Default: anonymously-pullable GHCR image published from this repo.
Min replicas for the Container App. 0 = scale-to-zero (cold start ~10s); 1 = always-warm.
Max replicas for the Container App.
Tags applied to every resource.
User-assigned managed identity used by the Container App.
Workspace-based Application Insights tied to a Log Analytics workspace.
Key Vault in RBAC mode for SE-supplied secrets (post-deploy).

Storage account hosting a private `backgrounds` blob container for avatar background images. Container is private (subscription policy denies public blob access); SEs upload custom backgrounds via Azure Portal Storage Browser and generate read-SAS URLs to paste into the runtime config panel.
Azure AI Foundry (AIServices) account with a project and a realtime model deployment for Voice Live.
